title: OOP1new and Libre 2 with Sync followers
symptom: On a non NFC master phone (KingKong Mini 2), when using a Libre 2 EU with OOP1new, versions above 2022.03.26 do not allow followers to receive data. Versions above 2021.10.13 start showing NFC block errors in master and follower. Libre blocks are received but ignored.
cause: A NullPointerException in BgReading when sorting data in NFCReaderX.parseData, triggered when processing Libre blocks with OOP1 enabled, prevents BG values from being saved and sent to followers.
fix: The issue was fixed by a version provided by tzachi-dar (link in comment) and later by pull request #2127. The user confirmed the provided version works fine.
